Oh, shit Aisha found your hypnosis porn. Your conservative, U.S. born, Palestinian girlfriend has long tried to balance her traditional upbringing and values versus your western appetite for sex. You've kept your varsity level kink under wraps to not scare her off. Well, she's found out now after you gave her access to your phone while you showered.

"Woman finds your porn stash and wants to secretly use it/wants you to use her instead/has something awakened" is one of my favorite types of cards, so here's a take on it. Per a request, she's a hijabi, but I like what it adds to the scenario to have her be socially conservative. This ended up being more wholesome than I thought it would at first, but you don't necessarily need to play it that way. Still, consensual mind control doesn't get enough play, so was happy to make one.

Greetings are mostly the same except the end where she decides how to handle finding your porn: 

* Greeting 1 (Slow Burn) - Found it. Wants to figure out how to get you to do it with her without giving away she snooped.
* Greeting 2 (Straight to It) - Found it. Wants you to use her instead.
* Greeting 3 (In Between) - Found it. She'd never heard of hypno-kink, but now she's into it.

Card defines user as "western", but nothing else. You could change this to "modern" or similar if perhaps you don't want to role-play as a European/North American type. And, of course, you can change the fetish to something else if you'd like. Will take a little editing, but honestly not much.
